goal: Preserve authoritative OpenRouter per-attempt billing receipts and separate generation/request IDs, with bounded explicit reconciliation; no route activation or cloud changes.
successCriteria: Adapter preserves usage.cost independently from upstream inference cost, generation ID independently from HTTP request ID, actual model and cache/reasoning counts.
Every OpenRouter attempt retains receipt even on malformed/blocked output; missing or invalid cost is unknown, never silently zero.
Explicit generation lookup verifies returned identity, bounded timeout and safe metadata; no extra completion calls or lookup added to interactive paths.
Existing provider/router tests, targeted failure/receipt tests and backend checks pass; live rollout and transactional quota settlement remain separate gates.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile, Admin layouts and existing published routes/provider secrets stay unchanged.
SQL, QA quota campaign, production allowlist, database and all deployed Edge Functions remain unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Existing shared OpenRouter adapter used by AI endpoints; tests use fictional requests and mocked fetch.
impact.dataWrite: Existing sanitized server model metadata includes receipt fields; no new tables or migrations, no durable settlement worker yet.
impact.backendContract: Backward-compatible optional billingReceipt per response/error/attempt; exact generation lookup only by explicit server caller.
impact.adminVisibility: Existing trace attributes can retain flattened safe cost/status/IDs; existing Admin cost dashboard is not changed into an actual-billing dashboard.
impact.privacySafety: Receipts allowlist only numeric billing and bounded IDs/models/provider labels; no request content, secret headers or raw lookup payload is persisted.
impact.observability: Preserve charged malformed/safety-blocked attempts and actual model; unknown cost remains pending, best-effort traces are not settlement authority.
impact.rollback: Revert optional receipt fields and helper; existing provider behavior and routes remain compatible, without any cloud retarget.

canonicalContracts: ModelProviderResponse/ModelProviderError/ModelGenerationResult carry optional OpenRouterBillingReceipt v1; no mobile contract or shared Council schema change.
usage.cost is the account charge; upstream inference cost remains separate; generation lookup total_cost may reconcile pending receipts.
